name: Python 3.12
notes: Requires python3 (>=3.10) installed on the sandbox host. Tested against CPython 3.12 (Ubuntu 24.04 default).

name: C++17 (g++ 13)
notes: Requires g++ >=10 on the sandbox host. Tested against GCC 13 (Ubuntu 24.04 default).

name: Go 1.22
compile_cmd: GOCACHE=/tmp/.gocache GOPATH=/tmp/.gopath go build -o main main.go
notes: Requires go >=1.20 on the sandbox host. Tested against Go 1.22. GOCACHE/GOPATH point to /tmp because the sandbox HOME is empty; /tmp is mounted by go-isolate.
